description: This file defines the ProjectActivityDecorator class within the OrangeHRM application. It acts as a decorator for ProjectActivity entities, providing methods to manipulate and set associated Project objects, primarily by ID.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the ProjectActivity entity, providing methods to interact with ProjectActivity objects and associate them with Projects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a specific ProjectActivity object.

methods.name: setProjectById
methods.description: Sets the project of the decorated ProjectActivity by the specified project ID.
